newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's senate budget commission approves DPEF.
newsitem.headline: Italy's senate budget commission approves DPEF.

text.p: The budget commission in the upper house of the Italian parliament approved the government's three-year economic targets (DPEF) on Wednesday.
The lower house budget commission had already voted its approval earlier in the day.
The government's hard-left Communist Refoundation allies voted against the DPEF in the senate after voting in favour of it in the lower house commission.
The centre-left government relies on Refoundation for a majority in the lower house but not in the upper one.

The full chamber of both houses are expected to vote on the package on Friday. The DPEF contains crucial indicators of targets the government intends to meet to ensure Italy honours criteria to join Europe's planned single currency.
